name: ZXZN Qi-House Holdings Limited
summary: ZXZN Qi-House Holdings Limited engages in the sale, distribution, and rental of furniture and home accessories under the TREE brand in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It operates in three segments: Furniture Sale and Consultancy Services; Sale of Trading Parts and Automation Equipment; and Consumer Loan Services. The company offers various furniture, including tables, chairs, storage solutions, sofas, and beds; and home accessories, such as kitchenware, bed and bathroom related products, jars, cushions, mattresses, utensils, and baskets.
